顾承安听完电话，把保密手机收好。

测试眼镜？测什么眼镜？不存在的。

处长都发话了，他还搁这磨叽什么。他二话不说掉转车头，电驴拧到底，直奔壹方天地。

跑外卖的时候大多数地方都去过，另外前身记忆力也还不错。壹方天地他熟，距离这儿二十多公里，正常骑行要三十多分钟。

今天路况还行，他抄了两段狭窄的近道，加上新买的九号确实给力，愣是提前十多分钟就到了。

找好位置停好电驴，顾承安摘下头盔，挂在车把上，大步走进商场。

XX超市在另一侧的负一楼。他走过化妆品柜台、奶茶店和抓娃娃机，拐进超市入口旁边的储物柜区域。

在开锁面板前站定，输入处长给的编码。

滴——

一个柜子弹开了。

顾承安先看了一眼。里面就一个文件袋，中间微微鼓起，没有其他东西了。

他才把文件袋取出来，关上柜门，转身就离开。

没有在这里打开。

他找了一间厕所，锁上门，撕开文件袋。

里面两样东西。

一把车钥匙。

一张纸条，上面手写了一串字符：B212。

顾承安拿着钥匙翻了翻。钥匙本身很普通，黑色塑料外壳，没有任何品牌LOGO标识。

纸条上的B212，是停车场车位号，这个不用猜。

他看着手里的钥匙，脑子转了一圈。

处长要送他一辆车。

不是吧？

这太突然了。

顾承安深吸一口气。此刻他的心情很复杂——就像拼夕夕砍价砍到最后一刀，页面告诉你“恭喜你即将免费获得一台iPhOne”，你知道大概率有惊喜，但又不敢完全相信。

他反复检查了一遍文件袋，里外都摸了，就是个普普通通的牛皮纸袋子，没有任何特殊的地方。

随后将文件袋撕得粉碎，扔进马桶，冲水，看着碎片全部消失，才开门出去。

职业习惯。

出了厕所，他先走到一层电梯外面的智能检索屏幕前，查了一下停车场的方位。负一层和负二层都有停车区域。

他先去了负一层，找到相应的车位。

停着一辆霸气的大揽胜。

略微激动的按下钥匙解锁键——没反应。

预料之中，顾承安转身走向负二层的楼梯口。

下了一层，车位编号从B200开始往后排。他一边走一边看，B208、B209、B210……

After Gu Chengan listened to the call, he put away his confidential mobile phone.

Testing glasses?What glasses are you testing?Doesn't exist.

The director has already spoken, why is he still fussing?Without saying a word, he turned the car around, turned the electric donkey to the end, and headed straight for Yifantiandi.

I have been to most places when I was running for takeout, and my memory was pretty good.The world is familiar to him, it is more than 20 kilometers away from here, and a normal ride takes more than 30 minutes.

The road conditions were not bad today. He took two narrow shortcuts, and the newly bought No. 9 was really powerful, so he arrived more than ten minutes early.

After finding a good spot and parking the e-donkey, Gu Chengan took off his helmet, hung it on the handlebar, and strode into the mall.

XX Supermarket is on the first negative floor on the other side.He walked past the cosmetics counter, the milk tea shop and the claw machine, and turned into the locker area next to the supermarket entrance.

Stand in front of the unlocking panel and enter the code given by the director.

Drop——

A cabinet popped open.

Gu Chengan took a look first.There was just a document bag inside, with a slight bulge in the middle, and nothing else.

He just took out the document bag, closed the cabinet door, turned around and left.

Not open here.

He found a bathroom, locked the door, and tore open the document bag.

There are two things in it.

A car key.

A note with a string of characters handwritten on it: B212.

Gu Chengan took the key and turned it over.The key itself is very ordinary, with a black plastic casing and no brand logo.

B212 on the note is the parking space number in the parking lot. No need to guess.

He looked at the key in his hand, his mind spinning.

The director wants to give him a car.

Isn't it?

It was too sudden.

Gu Chengan took a deep breath.At this moment, his mood is very complicated - just like Pinxixi bargaining down to the last price, the page tells you "Congratulations, you are about to get an iPhone One for free." You know that there is a high probability of a surprise, but you don't dare to believe it completely.

He checked the document bag again and again, touching both the inside and the outside. It was just an ordinary brown paper bag with nothing special about it.

Then he tore the document bag into pieces, threw it into the toilet, flushed it, and watched all the pieces disappear before opening the door and going out.

professional habits.

After leaving the toilet, he first walked to the smart search screen outside the elevator on the first floor and checked the direction of the parking lot.There are parking areas on the first and second floors below.

He first went to the negative floor and found the corresponding parking space.

Parked was a domineering large Range Rover.

I pressed the key unlock button with slight excitement - no response.

As expected, Gu Chengan turned around and walked towards the stairs to the second floor.

Going down one level, the parking spaces are numbered from B200 to the back.As he walked, he looked at B208, B209, B210...
